notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla defines SMSG_TRAINER_LIST (guid, type, count x 38-byte service records, greeting cstring), CMSG_TRAINER_LIST / CMSG_TRAINER_BUY_SPELL, and the BUY_SUCCEEDED/BUY_FAILED replies. MSUI's TrainerPackets.ParseList/ParseSuccess/ParseFailure and WorldSession's two sends match the wire field-for-field (including the two u32 primary-profession booleans and the three prerequisite spell slots), dispatched in Program.Net.cs.
